meta.summary: Targeted 2-row batch answering: are the two 'Delaware Express' rows redundant? NO — verified unrelated same-named assets (Targa NGL loop of Grand Prix vs Medallion/now-Plains crude shuttle). P7995: status proposed->operating (startup May 2026 per Targa Q1-2026 results 2026-05-07), length 100 mi + diameter 30 in filled, Parent filled Targa Resources Corp 100%, all refs replaced (old targaresources.com ref link-rotted). P0354: zero refs -> fully referenced; capacity corrected 250k->200k bpd (no source supports 250k), length 60->61 mi, flow direction corrected (Start/End swapped: Ward Co -> Crane Hub), StartYear 2019->2018 (FERC tariff filed 2018-07-01), ownership corrected to Plains Oryx Permian Basin (closed 2025-01-07) — NOT ONEOK, which bought the separate Midland-Basin Medallion.

redundancy_finding.question: Are P7995 and P0354 redundant entries?
redundancy_finding.answer: NO — keep both. Same project name, unrelated assets. P0354 (Medallion Delaware Express): crude oil, 61-mi/16-in shuttle, southern Delaware Basin field points (Reeves/Pecos/Ward Cos) east to Crane Hub, in service ~2018, owned by Medallion Delaware Express LLC (EMG-backed; sold to a Plains Oryx Permian Basin subsidiary Jan 2025). P7995 (Targa Delaware Express): NGL (y-grade), 100-mi/30-in intra-basin loop/expansion of Targa's Grand Prix NGL system, announced 2025-02-20, started up May 2026, Targa Resources Corp 100%. Different commodity, owner, diameter, length, vintage, route; no source connects them. Also distinct from Targa's Speedway NGL Pipeline (P7991, 500 mi, ISD 2027) — do not conflate.

Status.evidence: Targa Q1-2026 results PR/8-K (2026-05-07): 'In May 2026, starting up operation of our Delaware Express NGL Pipeline expansion.' Reuters carried the May 2026 startup same day (wire derives from the company statement -> not fully independent). Operator startup statement; re-check for full in-service confirmation next sweep.

LengthKnown.evidence: Targa Q4-2024 results PR (2025-02-20): 'Delaware Express, a 100-mile, 30-inch diameter pipeline expansion of its Grand Prix NGL Pipeline in the Permian Delaware'; East Daley Analytics note (2025-02-21): 'a 100-mile NGL pipe that will extend into the Delaware Basin' (derives from the same announcement -> single originating source -> medium). NEW PHYSICAL PIPE (loop), so length/diameter are filled, not zeroed (expansion convention applies only when no new pipe).

Diameter.evidence: 30-inch per the 2025-02-20 announcement (identical text in the same-day SEC 8-K Ex-99.1); no independent spec found -> medium.

EndLocation.evidence: Only disclosed as 'a pipeline expansion of its Grand Prix NGL Pipeline in the Permian Delaware' — intra-Delaware-Basin; no counties/plants/tie-ins published anywhere (SEC filings + trade press searched). More specific than the old generic wording; NOT a Mont Belvieu long-haul (that is Speedway, P7991).

Parent.evidence: Targa Resources Corp (NYSE: TRGP) describes the line as 'its'/'our' pipeline in every filing; Targa owns 100% of Grand Prix since the Jan 2023 Blackstone interest buyout. Public parent = the corp itself.

Fuel [ref].evidence: Old targaresources.com ref is link-rotted (ReadTimeout from two networks, 2026-06-12) — replaced on every ref cell of this row. NGL confirmed by company PR + East Daley.

Start [ref].evidence: StartYear1=2026 confirmed: guided Q3 2026 at announcement -> 'early completion' (Q2-2025 PR) -> Q2 2026 (FY2025 results 2026-02-19) -> started up May 2026 (Q1-2026 PR).

StartLocation [ref].evidence: 'in the Permian Delaware' — generic StartLocation kept (nothing more specific published).

confirmations.Fuel: NGL (y-grade) — company PRs + East Daley. High.
confirmations.Owner: Targa Resources Corp [100.%] — every filing 2025-02 through 2026-05. High.
confirmations.StartLocation: Permian Delaware Basin — consistent with all sources; nothing more specific published. Medium.

flags.ResearcherNotes_correction: Old note said announced Nov 2024 — wrong; SEC full-text search shows first mention is the 2025-02-20 Q4-2024 results 8-K/PR.

Capacity.evidence: No source anywhere states 250,000 bpd. Medallion site (archived 2023-01-17): '200,000 bpd Crude Oil Pipeline Hydraulic Capacity'; Oct 2017 open-season release: joint-tariff service 'up to 200,000 bpd'. Initial mainline capacity was 90,000 bpd (2017 release; World Pipelines 2017-10-20 is derivative). Two operator documents, same originator -> medium-high.

LengthKnown.evidence: 61-mile, 16-inch mainline: Business Wire 2019-04-12 (archived; live BW bot-walls) + OGJ 2019-07-01 (independent). Planned as 63 mi in the Oct 2017 release. Whole Delaware system incl. gathering is ~130-140 mi — 61 mi is the mainline.

StartYear1.evidence: No source states an explicit in-service date. FERC order 170 FERC ¶61,048 (OR19-34, 2020-01-23) fn.57: Delaware Express filed its implementing tariff 2018-07-01 (Docket IS18-661), effective by operation of law -> service ~Aug 2018. Operating by 2019-04-12 (Business Wire: 'existing Delaware Express pipeline system aggregates... and transports'). Inferred from tariff effectiveness -> medium; revert to 2019 if the inference is judged too thin.

StartLocation.evidence: FLOW DIRECTION WAS REVERSED in GEM. RRC Texas Tariff No. 2.6 (Medallion Delaware Express LLC, T-4 09805, eff. 2022-03-01): origins = field points in Pecos/Reeves/Ward Cos incl. Eagle Eye Station (Ward Co.) and Independence Station (Pecos Co.); SOLE DESTINATION = Crane Hub, Crane Co. Oct 2017 release: 'originating in Ward County and extending east to an interconnection with Medallion in Crane County'. Barstow is the Ward Co. town GEM already had (as End) — the label itself is map-derived/uncorroborated (no source names Barstow), but Ward Co. origin is high.

EndLocation.evidence: Crane Hub, Crane County = sole tariff destination (interconnects: EPIC Crude, Gray Oak, Medallion Pipeline Co, Plains terminal/Cactus access).

Fuel [ref].evidence: Crude oil: 2017 release + RRC tariff 'Crude Petroleum System'.

Status [ref].evidence: Operating: sold as an operating asset Jan 2025 (EMG seller release + Plains buyer release, independent parties).

Owner.old: Medallion Delaware Express LLC; Medallion Pipeline Co LLC
Owner.evidence: Medallion Pipeline Co LLC DROPPED — it owns the separate Midland-Basin system (GIP-owned, acquired by ONEOK Oct 2024) and was only the joint-tariff partner here, never an owner of this line (RBN 2019). The Delaware Express entity (Medallion Delaware Express LLC) was EMG-backed and sold intact (membership interests) via EMG Medallion 2 Holdings LLC to POPB DE Crude Holdings LLC, a Plains Oryx Permian Basin subsidiary; closed 2025-01-07, ~$160M, effective 2025-01-01.

OwnerEntityIDs.evidence: drop Medallion Pipeline Co LLC's ID with the owner

Parent.new: Plains All American Pipeline LP [65.00%]; Oryx Midstream Holdings LLC [35.00%]
Parent.evidence: Acquired by Plains Oryx Permian Basin LLC (via POPB DE Crude Holdings LLC), closed 2025-01-07 — buyer + seller + counsel + OGJ trade coverage all confirm. JV split: PAA 8-K Ex-99.1 (2021-10): 'durable JV structure that is owned 65% PAA / 35% Oryx'; Stonepeak completion release (2021-10-05) same language; Plains' net $105M of the $160M price (~65%) is consistent. Plains operates the JV. Oryx Midstream Holdings LLC is Stonepeak-backed — substitute Stonepeak Partners LP at 35% if GEM prefers ultimate-sponsor parents (cf. P2042/P0399 Oryx rows). Plains All American Pipeline LP exists as an entity (E100001014325 used as owner elsewhere); Plains Oryx Permian Basin LLC / Oryx Midstream Holdings LLC have no GOIT entity yet (entity_lookup 2026-06-12).

OtherEnglishNames.evidence: Disambiguates from Targa's same-named NGL project (P7995); 'Medallion Delaware Express' is the carrier name on the FERC/RRC tariffs.

confirmations.Status: operating — sold as operating asset Jan 2025 (EMG + Plains, independent). High.
confirmations.Fuel: crude oil — 2017 release + RRC tariff. High.

flags.StartLocation_label: 'Barstow' kept as the Ward Co. origin label but is itself uncorroborated (no source names the town; tariff names Eagle Eye Station, Ward Co.). Alternative: 'Eagle Eye Station (Ward County)'.

flags.ONEOK_disambiguation: ONEOK did NOT buy this line. ONEOK acquired the Midland-Basin Medallion (Medallion Pipeline Co/Medallion Midstream, GIP-owned) Aug-Oct 2024 ($2.6B). If any other GOIT row carries Medallion Pipeline Co LLC / Medallion Midstream LLC as owner, its parent is now ONEOK Inc — divestiture-sweep candidate (refs: prnewswire 2024-08-28 + 2024-10-31, verified by research agent).
flags.expansion_2019: Apr 2019 open season + FERC Docket OR19-28 (Federal Register 2019-06-27, govinfo.gov verified) added Reeves Co. gathering + mainline expansion; system reached the 200k bpd hydraulic figure by ~2022.

AggregateOwners.old: Medallion Delaware Express LLC; Medallion Pipeline Co LLC

Operator.evidence: Carrier of record per RRC Texas Tariff No. 2.6 (T-4 Permit 09805) and the FERC tariffs — tariff predates the Jan 2025 sale, hence medium. Day-to-day operatorship now sits with Plains as Plains Oryx JV operator ('Plains serves as operator of the JV', Stonepeak/PAA 2021-10-05).
